summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts, bumped its version 1.0.0->2.0.0 (breaking, per semver rule), updated core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports in a single PR #1 (libs/ is inlined at build time, so no registry release or lockfile change was needed; one PR avoids ordering issues).
